A single calibration pass, which is often acceptable for LLM PTQ, does not provide stable activation ranges for this setting.","importance":"The main relevance is inference efficiency rather than pretraining. The useful idea is to replace range estimation with a distributional quantization view: transform normalized activations into a basis where each coordinate follows a known marginal distribution, then use a fixed Lloyd–Max codebook. This is a useful design pattern for models with strong activation drift, including multimodal transformers and diffusion backbones. The paper also makes a practical point: DiT inference is more compute-bound than LLM decoding, so weight-only quantization is unlikely to give meaningful speedups; activation quantization is needed to reduce arithmetic cost.","technical_approach":"The method normalizes each activation vector by its L2 norm, applies a randomized orthogonal rotation, and quantizes the rotated coordinates with an offline Lloyd–Max scalar codebook. Under a Haar-random rotation, each coordinate of a normalized vector has a fixed dimension-dependent marginal, well approximated by N(0, 1/d) for moderate dimensions. OrbitQuant implements this idea with a randomized permuted block-Hadamard rotation, which is cheaper than a dense random orthogonal matrix and empirically keeps low-bit coordinates well behaved. The same rotated basis is used for weights: rotations can be folded into weight rows offline, so weights and activations are quantized in a shared basis and the linear-layer computation remains consistent. Unlike SmoothQuant-style methods, it does not rely on calibrated activation scales; unlike many DiT PTQ methods, it does not refit ranges for each timestep, prompt, checkpoint, or modality.","experiments":"The paper evaluates image and video DiTs using GenEval and VBench. accuracy.","starred":false,"priority":"p2","reading_tier":"skim","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"2026-07-02T07:52:43Z","category_id":"efficient","cover_url":"/covers/2607_01831.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.DC","cs.LG"],"summary":{"core_problem":"这篇工作处理的是长上下文、分离式推理里的一个具体瓶颈：Prefill 端生成的 KV cache 需要跨网络传给 Decode 端，而 Decode 往往必须等整份 KV 到齐后才能开始。上下文一长，KV 体积线性增长，网络传输就会直接暴露在首 token 延迟里。已有 KV 量化方法虽然能缩小传输量，但通常在两点之间做艰难取舍：要么压得狠、延迟低，但注意力误差变大，生成质量掉得明显；要么保守量化，精度较稳，但 TTFT 改善有限。Lynx 试图打破的不是单纯“如何把 KV 压得更小”，而是“KV 是否必须作为一个不可分割的整体被完整接收后才能使用”这个系统假设。","importance":"对基座研究本身，它不是预训练方法论文，但对大模型系统设计有直接启发，尤其是长上下文 serving、PD-disaggregation、远程 KV 检索这类越来越常见的部署形态。它的重要性在于把 KV 量化从“静态压缩问题”改成了“分层信息传输 + 可验证近似推理”的联合问题：先传最关键的高位信息，让模型尽早开始 decode，再在后台补齐低位残差，并用 speculative verification 保证最终采样分布与全精度一致。这种思路对后续很多系统问题都有参考价值，比如分阶段状态传输、分辨率渐进式上下文恢复、以及把近似计算包进可校验框架里。对做训练的人，启发主要在于：模型内部状态并不是所有 bit 同等重要，系统层可以利用这种不均匀性，而不必把张量视作刚性对象。","technical_approach":"方法由三部分组成。第一部分是 Hierarchical Split-Stream Quantization。作者把 KV 不是压成单一路径的低比特表示，而是显式拆成 Anchor 和 Residual 两条流。Anchor 保留高价值、粗粒度的信息，用来尽快恢复一个可用但不完全精确的 KV；Residual 再补充细节，逐步逼近原始状态。这里的关键不是简单高低位切分，而是结合非线性对数量化和 outlier-aware chunking，尽量在固定 bit budget 下保住 attention 输出分布。对数量化适合处理 KV 中动态范围不均的问题；outlier-aware chunking 则避免少数极端值把整块量化尺度拉坏。\n\n第二部分是 Split-Stream Pipelining Architecture。系统层面，Lynx 让网络优先发送 Anchor 流，Decode 端在只拿到部分 KV 状态时就启动计算，而 Residual 在后台继续传输和反序列化。这里需要自定义的序列化/反序列化协议和 non-blocking runtime，避免传统“收齐—解压—装载—再算”的串行路径。论文强调的不只是网络传输时间，还包括 deserialize 和把 KV 装入 paged device memory 的开销，因此它把通信和运行时一起做了设计。\n\n第三部分是 Speculative Decoding Verification。因为基于 Anchor 的早期 decode 仍然是近似的，作者借用 speculative decoding 的验证机制：先用部分信息生成候选 token，再用完整或更精确状态验证。如果候选通过验证，最终输出分布与未量化全精度模型一致；如果不通过，则回退。这个设计很关键，因为它把“快但近似”的系统优化包进了一个有形式保证的采样框架里，避免只追求平均精度而牺牲分布一致性。\n\n和已有 KV quantization 方法相比，Lynx 的区别主要有三点。第一，已有方法多把 KV 当成一次性压缩、一次性恢复的对象，Lynx 则把它视作可渐进恢复的状态。第二，已有方法通常只优化压缩率和重建误差，Lynx 直接优化网络暴露延迟。第三，已有方法的精度退化往往是不可逆的，而 Lynx 通过 verification 把最终生成质量拉回到与全精度一致的目标上。","experiments":"论文给出的代表性结果是：在长上下文、带宽受限的分离式推理场景下，Lynx 达到接近 INT4 级别的 KV 传输延迟，同时保持接近 INT8 或 BF16 的推理精度。相对 INT8 baseline，TTFT 最多降低 30.5%，Time-to-32nd-Token 最多降低 10.7%；相对 CacheGen，推理准确率最多高 5.1%。这些收益在更长上下文和更低带宽下更明显，这和方法设计是对齐的，因为此时网络传输更容易成为主瓶颈。\n\n文中还给了一个很直观的规模例子：Qwen3-235B-A22B 在 128k sign","starred":false,"priority":"p2","reading_tier":"skim","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"2026-07-01T08:03:30Z","category_id":"efficient","cover_url":"/covers/2607_02593.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.CV","cs.CL"],"summary":{"core_problem":"这篇工作讨论的是多模态大模型蒸馏里一个很具体但常被处理得过于粗糙的问题：到底应该蒸馏哪一类跨模态注意力。已有方法通常把 distilling. Prior work mostly emphasizes prompt-to-vision attention, assuming that better visual grounding during prompt encoding should transfer to the student. The authors show that this is largely the wrong target. What correlates with downstream performance is response-to-vision attention, namely how the model attends to visual tokens while generating each response token. They also show that this signal is highly heterogeneous across tokens, so a uniform distillation objective is poorly matched to the structure of the problem.","importance":"This is not a core pretraining paper, but it is relevant to multimodal foundation-model training and compression. The generative phase carries the more useful supervision. That insight is useful for MLLM compression, teacher-student alignment, and potentially for designing better multimodal training objectives where grounding quality matters during decoding rather than only during input fusion.","technical_approach":"$4f","experiments":"$50","reading_guide":"This is a skim paper. This metric fails to separate irreducible single-sample noise from reproducible performance gains achievable by routing to a specialist model, leading to misestimation of routing upper bounds and misaligned optimization targets.","importance":"This work identifies and corrects a systematic upward bias in the standard oracle metric widely used in LLM routing research. It provides a rigorous gap decomposition framework and standardized measurement protocol, with direct practical value for MoE routing design, multi-model pool serving scheduling, and fair evaluation of routing methods, preventing wasted optimization effort on irrecoverable noise components.","technical_approach":"Correctness for each (query, model) pair under non-zero temperature is modeled as a Bernoulli random variable. The standard single-draw oracle, which takes the maximum over these binary single samples, is formally proved to be an upward-biased estimator. An exact non-negative decomposition is derived: the router-to-expected-oracle gap splits into two parts: (1) reproducible specialist advantage, the upper bound achievable by any single-commit router, and (2) single-draw label noise, which no single-commit router can capture and is only accessible via test-time resampling. Closed-form bias expressions and lower bounds on noise share are derived for scenarios including homogeneously hard queries and low model reliability. It separates visual perception from multimodal fusion. A model can succeed in an image-only setting and still choose the wrong source when pixels and structure disagree. For native multimodal training, this suggests that grounding should be evaluated under controlled channel conflict, not only under aligned inputs. Each probe contains a real screenshot, a serialized structure, a target region, a discrete state variable, and a gold value defined by what is visible in the pixels. The main contrast keeps the screenshot at the true value a while editing the corresponding structural value to a conflicting value b. If the model answers b under the fused input, its belief is attributed to structure. The Perception-Fusion Gap is computed on probes where the model is correct in the image-only condition, so it measures a failure of fusion rather than a failure of perception. The benchmark avoids model-generated items and model judges: conflicts are rule-based edits and answers are deterministic forced choices. This method reuses historical evaluation data, skips generation and scoring for a subset of prompts to cut costs, and comes with rigorous statistical validity guarantees, making it suitable for long-term, batch model iteration evaluation.","technical_approach":"The full model × prompt score matrix is split into dense historical scores from anchor models and sparse observed scores from new target models. Matrix completion imputes missing entries, then cross-prediction-powered inference (CrossPPI) uses these imputations as control variates to reduce estimation variance while preserving unbiasedness and asymptotically valid confidence intervals. The framework is agnostic to evaluation metrics, matrix completion algorithms, and anchor set composition; it gracefully degrades to classical estimation if imputations are uncorrelated with true scores, and supports both pointwise metric estimation and pairwise model difference calculation.","experiments":"Tested across 5 diverse text generation benchmarks and multiple real-world evaluation settings. Compared to classical inference, confidence interval width is reduced by up to 30%; the magnitude of variance reduction scales with the squared covariance between true target model scores and matrix completion imputations.","reading_guide":"Start with the problem framing in the introduction and the core intuition diagram in Figure 1, then skim the method section for the combined matrix completion + CrossPPI pipeline and its statistical guarantees. confidence estimation for localization outputs generated by MLLMs. These models can emit boxes for images and temporal windows for video or audio, but many predicted regions are hallucinated. Token log-probabilities are a poor confidence signal because they mix grounding quality with input ambiguity, and coordinate tokens often become nearly deterministic once the model commits to a region.","importance":"The work is not a pretraining recipe, but it is useful for multimodal foundation-model research. It shows that grounding quality can be probed from how strongly the generated prediction tokens attend to the region they claim. This gives a training-free signal for localization reliability, output reranking, data filtering, and possibly reward construction for future grounding-oriented post-training. It also argues that MLLMs used as localization systems should be evaluated with detection-style metrics such as AP, Recall@1, and PSDS1, not only with VQA or captioning benchmarks.","technical_approach":"The proposed score, Multi-Token Localized Attention (MTLA), is a post-hoc confidence measure. For a predicted region, MTLA aggregates decoder attention from all tokens belonging to the prediction and restricts the modality-side aggregation to tokens inside the predicted box or temporal window. This differs from earlier attention-based hallucination detectors in two ways. It is localized: attention outside the claimed region is not treated as direct evidence. It is multi-token: the score uses the full prediction, including label and coordinate or time tokens, rather than a single object sub-token. The resulting score measures whether the prediction is supported by evidence in the region it points to. It requires no additional training and is intended to work across image, video, and audio localization.","experiments":"The experiments cover several model families and localization settings across modalities. A key empirical finding is that 58% to 68% of regions emitted by strong MLLMs do not correspond to valid objects or events on the evaluated benchmarks. Token probability provides weak separation between grounded and hallucinated predictions. MTLA improves hallucination detection, enables training-free suppression of unreliable outputs, and improves ranking under standard localization metrics. The clearest reported number is on zero-shot COCO detection: using MTLA as the confidence score raises AP for an 8B generalist MLLM from 20.4 to 37.0. speech 条件和 text continuation 绑在一起；segment-level 更稳，也更容易构造。其二，行为一致性。text-only 样本、ASR 样本、interleaved 样本都统一成“给定前缀，预测后续文本 token”的形式，避免 speech 分支和 text 分支学成两套相互割裂的解码习惯。其三，减少 modality gap。交错后，模型在同一条序列里反复经历 speech→text、text→speech-like context、再到 text continuation 的切换，等于把原来只在 batch 级别共存的两种模态，拉到 token/segment 级别共同参与上下文建模。\n\n作者还强调，他们故意采用确定性交替，而不是随机选择哪些片段用 speech、哪些片段用 text。这样做不是因为最优，而是为了隔离 interleaving granularity 和 boundary construction 的影响，先把机制看清楚。训练实现上，多个样本 pack 到 8k context 时，用 packed SFT 和 cu_seqlens 保证样本边界 attention reset，避免跨样本泄漏。","experiments":"实验主设置基于 38k 小时内部 ASR 数据，目标是看 JSTIP 相比 ASR-only 和简单 speech-text joint training 是否更能把文本知识转成 ASR 增益。摘要里给出的主结果是：相对 ASR-only，实体识别相关指标最高有 17.2% 的相对提升，而且这种提升在不同设置下都比较稳定。作者特别强调，收益主要体现在 entity accuracy，而不是只看通用 WER/CER，这和论文的问题定义一致：他们关心的是 LLM 文本先验能否帮助长尾词和领域实体。\n\n另一个关键结果是领域场景实验。作者比较了两种补充领域知识的方式：一种是加入 transcription-only 的领域文本，另一种是构造 synthetic domain ASR data。JSTIP 下，仅用领域转写文本就能做到与合成领域 ASR 数据相近的实体表现。这说明 interleaving generative behavior 没有被完全冲掉。\n\n从消融角度，全文最值得注意的不是单个数字，而是作者的因果链条：1）ASR-only 随着监督数据增加会更依赖 speech-text alignment 而非 LLM prior；2）简单 joint training 虽然加入了 text-only batch，但对 ASR 的迁移有限；3）把 speech 和 text answer 之间插入 S 个特殊的 <|lvc|> token。这些 token 的隐藏状态不作为普通词表 token 来预测，而是作为确定性的 recurrent computation state，用来保存压缩后的时空语义。论文把原始视频 token 称为 main memory，把 latent cache 看作更靠近解码过程的高速缓存。训练分两阶段。第一阶段是 SFT，同时加入 supervised contrastive cache alignment，把 cache hidden states 投影回视觉空间，并与关键帧 embedding 对齐，避免 latent slot 退化为空占位符。第二阶段使用 vision-grounded GRPO，奖励包括 answer reward、format reward、temporal reward 和 latent The paper turns the vague claim that understanding and generation help each other into a controlled capability-transfer question. The result is that transfer depends strongly on how much representation is shared. A fully shared transformer with a unified visual encoder shows clearer transfer, while loosely coupled designs show little or unstable transfer. This matters for unified AR-plus-diffusion systems and native multimodal pretraining: simply placing tasks inside one product-level model is not enough. The representation path has to be shared if capabilities are expected to move across tasks. The work also suggests a practical post-training route: when direct generation fine-tuning causes distribution shift or visual-quality loss, train the corresponding understanding capability and let it transfer through shared representations.","technical_approach":"The authors use counting as a probe because it is measurable and required by both understanding and generation. The useful representation depends on both depth and corruption level. Moderate noise levels expose more globally separable semantic features. Lower noise levels preserve details, but those details are spatially scattered, so simple pooling loses information and attention-based decoding is more effective. Gen4U then turns this analysis into a feature extraction pipeline: freeze the generative backbone, choose an appropriate block and noise level, run a single forward pass, and train lightweight task decoders. This differs from using the diffusion model through a full denoising trajectory; the expensive generation process is replaced by one representation extraction pass.","experiments":"The evaluation covers a proprietary model, Veo3, and an open-weight model, Wan2.2-T2V-A14B. The data pipeline has two neuron-based components. Neuron Consensus measures reliability using activation statistics, especially the number of activated neurons. The paper reports that this signal correlates with hallucinated or unreliable behavior, but is not sufficient as a standalone selection rule. Neuron Overlap retrieves demonstrations whose active-neuron patterns are close to the current query, aiming to induce a more useful teacher distribution. The main distinction from standard self-training is that context construction is treated as part of the supervision design, not as a fixed prompting detail.","experiments":"The experiments cover three datasets and six source domains. Neuron-OPSD is reported to deliver competitive self-improvement while preserving cross-domain generalization and calibration better than SFT-based self-training, GRPO-style variants, and reward-based on-policy RL. Additional analysis suggests that the gains depend on both the model’s initial capability on the training data and the distributional gap induced between teacher and student. Ablations on four SciKnowEval domains show that neuron consensus is informative but insufficient by itself, while neuron-overlap retrieval is a more direct mechanism for improving teacher-context quality. 使用这些 memory，student 本身不依赖推理时外部记忆。Level-0 experience memory 存原始轨迹、奖励、反馈，保真度最高，但泛化最弱；Level-1 insight memory 对同一问题的多次尝试做反思，抽取策略与 lesson，压缩掉冗余轨迹细节；Level-2 behavior memory 把语义相关的问题聚类，进一步归纳成跨问题可复用的 reasoning pattern，迁移性最强，但也最容易过粗。训练时，当前 policy 先生成 rollouts，经 verifier 或反馈打分后写入 memory；更新后的 memory 再去条件化 self-teacher，teacher 生成更丰富的监督信号，student 用这些 on-policy 状态上的 teacher targets 学习。这里和 SDPO 的关键区别是：SDPO 的 teacher 主要来自同组 sibling rollout 或局部反馈，仍然是 episode-local；PMD 则把前几轮训练中积累的 insight/behavior 一并喂给 teacher，使 teacher 能利用跨 epoch 的程序知识。作者强调 memory 与 policy 必须共同演化：如果 memory 固定，它会越来越不匹配当前策略访问到的状态；如果 policy 固定，memory 也无法随着能力提升而抽取更高质量的 insight。这个设计选择很重要，因为它把 memory 从静态检索库变成训练中的动态 scaffold。另一个值得注意的点是，PMD 明确避免 inference-time memory dependency。很多 reflection/memory agent 方法把外部记忆带到部署阶段，换来更强能力但也引入系统复杂度和分布偏移；PMD 的取舍是只在训练时用 memory，目标是把程序知识内化进权重。","experiments":"文中给出的主结果比较清楚。作者在两个可验证领域上评估：SCIKNOWEVAL 和 LIVECODEBENCH，底座模型包括 Qwen3-8B 与 OLMo3-Instruct-7B。相对 GRPO 和 SDPO，PMD 在 compute scaling 更好：随着 rollout budget 增加，PMD 继续受益，而 SDPO 更早饱和，二者差距会随采样预算扩大。按照方法设计，这个现象是合理的，因为 PMD 改善的是程序先验和 teacher 质量，不只是单次采样命中率。摘要里还点出 Level-1 insight 与 Level-2 behavior As reasoning models continue to scale, re-running RLVR from scratch for every new strong model risks turning post-training itself into a bottleneck. Directly distilling the final post-RL policy of a small model performs poorly, because the final policy entangles useful RL-induced improvements with the intrinsic capacity limits of the smaller model, and can overwrite stronger behavior already present in the student.","importance":"It introduces a new weak-to-strong post-training paradigm that treats small-model RL as a cheap generator of transferable supervision rather than a final teacher to imitate. The paradigm partially decouples post-training cost from target model size, substantially reducing the compute overhead of reasoning enhancement for large models. The core implication for pretraining research is that RL-learned improvements can be transferred across models in the form of a policy shift, without requiring an explicit reward model or a full RL rerun on the large model; this opens a new mechanism for signal reuse and cross-model knowledge transfer in the pretrain-posttrain loop.","technical_approach":"Direct On-Policy Distillation (Direct-OPD) does not distill the final post-RL small-model policy π_T, but instead distills the policy shift Δ_T = log π_T - log π_{T_ref}, where π_{T_ref} is the small-model reference policy before RL. This shift retains only the probability changes caused by RL and discards the small model's original preferences, avoiding the transfer of the teacher's capacity limits to the student. It is mathematically proven that under a KL-regularized RL objective, this policy shift is equivalent to the reward signal that trained the small model: optimizing against it recovers the same objective form as the original RL. During training, the student samples on its own on-policy states, uses the shift as an implicit reward, and is anchored to its own initialization via a KL term — no explicit reward model training or sparse-reward RL on the target model is required.","experiments":"Evaluated with two teacher pairs (R1-Distill-1.5B→JustRL-1.5B, Nemotron-1.5B→QuestA-Nemotron-1.5B) and three students from two families (R1-Distill-7B, Qwen3-1.7B, Qwen3-4B). All students improve, including R1-Distill-7B and Qwen3-4B whose initial performance already exceeds the post-RL weak teacher. Qwen3-1.7B improves from 48.3 to 62.4 on AIME 2024 in roughly 4 hours on 8 A100 GPUs, on par with Polaris running RL directly on Qwen3-1.7B for at least a week on 32 A100 GPUs. At matched RL steps, running RL on a 1.5B model plus Direct-OPD transfer outperforms running RL directly on R1-Distill-7B in both accuracy and compute efficiency. Analysis shows the method does not rely on teacher-student top-k overlap and transfers across thinking patterns; response-length and KL conditions under which the implicit reward stays aligned with validation accuracy are identified.","reading_guide":"Read Section 2.2 carefully for the mathematical proof that policy shift is equivalent to the KL-regularized RL reward — this is the theoretical foundation of the entire method. As a generator, it modifies a non-challenging prompt by appending an atomic constraint and adding the corresponding rubric criterion. Each seed prompt receives a base rubric once, and the method keeps the seed prompt and base rubric largely intact while adding constraints when needed. The choice of appending rather than rewriting is deliberate: it preserves the source task distribution while increasing difficulty in a controlled way. Ablations indicate that targeted policy-aware constraint appending is better than unconditional appending, random appending, or adapting prompts based on a stronger model’s responses. Appending constraints also works better than rewriting prompts. The analysis shows that the tutor’s pairwise judgments correlate with empirical difficulty, that appended constraints increase reward discriminativeness, and that the prompt modification rate rises with policy scale. token 聚合 trajectory-level KL 时，浅层 turn 因为更频繁、KL 更大、token 更多而占据大部分 loss，深层关键决策得不到足够训练。","importance":"贡献主要在 post-training 和 agent training，但对预训练研究也有接口价值。它把“训练预算如何沿时间步分配”从 token 层推进到 turn 层，给长程交互模型提供了一个可操作的诊断框架。对 RL pretrain、agentic continual pretrain、tool-use mid-training 都有借鉴意义：当训练样本是模型自己生成的多步轨迹时，不能默认完整轨迹和 token-level averaging 是合理的。实验量级上，TurnOPD 在保持或提升准确率的同时最高把训练 wall-clock 缩短到 1/2.29，属于明确的训练效率改进，而不是只在指标上做小幅调参。","technical_approach":"方法由两个 turn-level budget controller 组成。第一是 adaptive rollout-depth controller。它不是每次都 rollout 到最大轮数，而是周期性 probe 不同深度，根据 survivor-weighted KL 和 coverage threshold 选择当前训练阶段的 rollout horizon。直觉是：如果某些后段 turn 很少被轨迹走到，或者 teacher-student KL 已经低到监督质量不足，继续采样完整尾部的性价比很低；但又不能过早截断，否则深层决策永远没有覆盖。因此控制器同时使用 effective KL quality 和 coverage lower bound，图示中以 H=max(Heff, Hcov) 的方式在“有监督信号”和“有足够覆盖”之间取保守边界。第二是 progressive turn-normalized loss controller。标准 token-normalized KL 会让浅层 turn 主导优化；严格 turn-normalization 又可能把少量、噪声较大的深层样本权重放得过高。TurnOPD 用线性混合 Lmix=(1-a)Ltoken+aLround，并让 a 随训练进度从 0 增加到 1。早期先稳定学习基本交互模式，后期逐步提高深层 turn 的相对权重。与 vanilla OPD 的区别在于，它同时控制“收集多长轨迹”和“loss 如何在 turn 之间分配”，而不是只改变采样长度或只做 loss reweighting。","experiments":"作者先给出诊断结果：在 ALFWorld 上，最深 1/3 turns 只获得 3.6–4.5% 的总 KL loss；在 Multi-Hop Search 上也只有 11–13%。这说明 token-level KL 聚合会系统性压低深层决策的训练信号。评测覆盖三类多轮 agent 任务：embodied planning 的 ALFWorld，web navigation 的 WebShop，以及 Multi-Hop 倍训练加速。WebShop 上准确率和时间同时改善，wall time 从 1.57h 降到 1.24h。消融结果支持两个模块的分工：adaptive depth 是主要效率来源，在 ALFWorld-1.7B 上接近减半 wall time，但单独使用不能解决 loss allocation；linear KL blending 主要提升 Same-Step Avg@4，因为它把监督重新分配给更深的 turn。coverage-floor 消融说明 rollout horizon 可以在保守和激进之间连续调节，而不是依赖单个脆弱阈值。","reading_guide":"建议精读，预计 60–90 分钟。先看 introduction 和 Figure 1，抓住 external mismatch 与 internal mismatch：前者是 已对齐，还是表示自生成上下文污染后 teacher 监督也变弱；这会影响 controller 在更强 teacher、更大 student 或 RL 混合训练中的可靠性。","authors_note":""},"summary_en":{"core_problem":"TurnOPD addresses budget allocation in on-policy distillation familiar pathology of outcome-only RL for reasoning: the reward grades only the final answer, not the reasoning trace, so on hard problems the model is often incentivized to write longer rather than think better. If a longer chain increases the chance of stumbling into the correct answer, GRPO reinforces that behavior. The result is inflated traces full of hedging, retries, and filler, with much weaker gains in reasoning quality per token. Direct process supervision is unattractive because there is no reliable, verifiable label for “good thinking.” The paper’s alternative is to let another model implicitly grade the usefulness of a trace through competition: if an opponent can read your work and still beat you, your reasoning did not create a robust advantage.","importance":"The interesting idea is to recast process reward as a game rather than a labeling problem. It is a practical tooling contribution, with limited direct relevance to base model pretraining.","technical_approach":"Two stability modifications are made to the RFM-AGOP framework to support multi-dimensional subspace extraction. First, the original identity matrix initialization is replaced with a probe-informed starting point: a simple linear probe is trained to separate activations from harmful and harmless queries, and the initial feature matrix is constructed from the probe weight vector plus the rank-k truncated covariance of activations. This fixes the original RFM’s sensitivity to hyperparameters and tendency to diverge from the primary direction in early iterations. Second, exponential moving average is applied to AGOP matrix updates to reduce iteration noise. After convergence, the top-k eigenvectors of the final feature matrix span the refusal subspace; no gradient optimization is required through the whole process. The method uses a Mahalanobis Laplace kernel, and iterates between kernel ridge regression and AGOP updates.","experiments":"Evaluations are run on Qwen 2.5 (non-reasoning) and Qwen 3 (reasoning model, with CoT up to 8000 tokens). For each naturally terminated completion, they define the target at position t as r_t = T - t, the number of tokens remaining until EOS. They extract residual-stream activations at each layer and train a single linear probe, with no nonlinear capacity, to predict r_t. Two baselines are important. The first is a constant median predictor over the training split, which captures dataset-level length statistics. The second predicts total completion length from the prompt-final hidden state and then performs an exact countdown by position, separating prompt-level length estimation from mid-generation updates. The cross-dataset transfer matrices are central because they test whether the learned direction is tied to one dataset’s length distribution or reflects a more general representation inside the model.","experiments":"The paper reports three main findings. First, total completion length is linearly decodable from the final prompt hidden state before any output token is generated. Second, during generation, a Remaining Count Probe can predict remaining length with roughly 30-token MAE on completions around 400 tokens long. This is not exact counting; it is a coarse but stable signal. Third, probes trained on natural-language datasets transfer broadly to other natural-language and some synthetic targets, while probes trained on synthetic Count/Countdown data mainly transfer within that synthetic pair and fail on natural-language targets. A qualitative retraction example shows the predicted remaining length rising after tokens such as “Wait, let me try again,” which a position-only countdown cannot explain. The authors appropriately treat this as directional evidence because a length-matched non-retraction control is still missing.","reading_guide":"A 20–30 minute skim is enough. in the same sense as overparameterized supervised models, and argues that they generally do not.","importance":"The main lesson for foundation-model research is that generalization mechanisms depend strongly on the training objective. A score network is not just a regression model with a different data loader; it learns a denoising vector field indexed by noise time. In high-dimensional finite-data regimes, fitting that field too closely can move the model toward memorization rather than harmless interpolation. This matters for diffusion language models, masked diffusion pretraining, and multimodal AR-plus-diffusion systems: larger models and lower training loss should not be assumed to imply benign generalization. Noise schedules, time smoothness, regularization, and stopping criteria become part of the generalization story.","technical_approach":"The paper combines architecture-independent theory, a solvable random-feature model, and image-generation experiments. The theoretical part establishes negative results showing that empirical and population score-matching losses cannot both be small in practical high-dimensional settings unless the sample size grows exponentially with dimension. This rules out the usual benign-overfitting picture for most relevant regimes. The simplified linear random-feature analysis then makes the mechanism explicit: as model complexity increases, the score estimator can fit the finite-sample denoising field around training points instead of approximating the population score. The authors contrast this with classical regression, where overparameterization can induce a form of self-regularization. They also identify sources of regularization that can help in diffusion training, especially smoothness across diffusion time and early stopping.","experiments":"In the random-feature experiments, excess risk follows a classical U-shaped curve as complexity increases rather than a double-descent curve. Small models underfit, intermediate models generalize better, and sufficiently expressive models move toward overfitting or stop improving. In high-dimensional image-generation experiments with U-Net-style diffusion models, increasing the number of U-Net features shows a similar qualitative transition: poor generation at low capacity, a generalization regime at intermediate capacity, and stronger training-set memorization when over-trained at higher capacity. The available text does not provide exact FID values, dataset sizes, feature counts, or dimensionalities, so the safe reading is qualitative: the result is about the shape of the generalization curve and the incompatibility between very low train loss and low population score-matching loss in high dimension.","reading_guide":"A 30–45 minute skim is appropriate, with deeper reading if diffusion pretraining is relevant. The setup distinguishes context-only correlations from query-context correlations. In the first case, the query remains independent, so the main effect is a reduction in the number of effectively independent examples. In the second case, the query shares the same sequential structure as the context, giving the model additional information for inference. When the query is correlated with the context, test loss drops across all model classes, indicating that the models exploit the added statistical structure. The gap between linear attention and softmax attention becomes larger in this regime, suggesting an architectural mismatch that is hidden in the i.i.d. setting. wi","starred":false,"priority":"p2","reading_tier":"must_read","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"2026-07-06T17:55:12Z","category_id":"agent","cover_url":"/covers/2607_05378.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.LG"],"summary":{"core_problem":"CompactionRL 解决的是长程 agent RL 中的上下文瓶颈：交互轨迹会超过固定 context window，但简单扩大上下文代价高，推理时做摘要又没有被训练目标约束。核心问题是，如何在固定工作上下文预算下，把“执行任务”和“压缩历史”一起纳入 RL，让模型学会生成会影响后续决策的摘要。","importance":"这篇属于 post-train 与 pretrain 接口上的重要方法工作。它不是单纯做长上下文推理技巧，而是把 context compaction 变成策略的一部分，并把摘要 token 放进同一个任务奖励优化回路。对基座研究的启发有三点。第一，长程能力不一定只靠更长 context，也可以靠可训练的状态压缩。第二，agent RL 的训练单位不再天然是完整 rollout；压缩会把一条轨迹切成长度不同、时间位置不同的 segment，损失归一化和 credit assignment 会直接影响训练信号质量。第三，summary 不是外部 memory 组件，而是模型要学习的中间状态表示，这与持续预训练、长程记忆和 latent state modeling 都有联系。","technical_approach":"方法基于 PPO，而不是沿用 GRPO 式的 group-relative 完整 rollout 优化。原因是 compaction 会让每个任务产生数量可变的轨迹段，固定 group normalization 很难处理段长、压缩次数和时间距离的差异。CompactionRL 在 rollout collection 中加入压缩机制：当历史长度接近上下文预算 C，剩余空间低于阈值 T_comp 时，系统追加固定 summarization instruction，由当前可训练 policy 生成 summary；随后用 summary 加最近一小段交互历史重建 context，agent 继续执行任务。assistant action 和 summary generation 都作为 policy 产生的 token，被同一个最终任务奖励优化。两个技术细节很关键。第一是 token-level loss normalization，用来减少长 summary 或长 action 在 context window, while inference-time summarization is not optimized by the task reward. The goal is to train the model to execute the task and to generate the compacted state that later decisions will depend on.","importance":"This is a strong post-training method with clear implications for foundation-model training. It treats context compaction as a learned policy action rather than an external memory heuristic. The contribution matters because long-horizon ability does not have to come only from larger context windows; it can also come from trained state compression under a fixed context budget. It also exposes a training issue that is easy to miss: once a rollout is split by compaction, segment length, segment position, and delayed reward all affect the quality of the RL signal.","technical_approach":"The method is built on PPO. The choice is deliberate: group-relative methods such as GRPO assume groups of comparable complete rollouts, while compaction creates a variable number of segments per task. During rollout collection, when the remaining context budget falls below a threshold, the model receives a fixed summarization instruction and samples a summary using the current policy. The next context is reconstructed from that summary plus a short tail of recent interaction, and the agent continues the task. Both ordinary action tokens and summary tokens are optimized under the same final task reward. Two design choices carry most of the method. Token-level loss normalization reduces bias from segments or summaries with different lengths. Cross-trajectory GAE preserves temporal credit assignment across compaction boundaries, so that the final outcome can still assign credit or blame to summary tokens generated much earlier.","experiments":"The reported experiments focus on long-horizon agentic coding. On GLM-4.7-Flash, CompactionRL improves over a base model with inference-time compaction by 5.5 points on SWE-bench Verified and 6.8 points on Terminal-Bench 2.0. On GLM-4.5-Air, the gains are 7.0 and 3.1 points on the same two benchmarks. These numbers indicate that training the compaction behavior is better than adding summarization only at inference time. The setup is also realistic for agent RL: the summary has no separate supervision, and its usefulness is learned through sparse task-level reward.","reading_guide":"Read carefully.
